name: Marco Pavone
title: Associate Professor of Aeronautics and Astronautics, Senior Fellow at the Precourt Institute for Energy and Associate Professor, by courtesy, of Electrical Engineering & of Computer Science
department: Aeronautics and Astronautics (courtesy appointments in Electrical Engineering and Computer Science)
research_topics: Embodied AI agents and grounded reasoning
Physical AI safety, monitoring and guardrailing
Data flywheels for robotics (automated evaluation and data curation)
Optimal and learning-based control and planning
Space robotics and spacecraft trajectory optimization
Future mobility systems and fleet coordination
current_direction: Making vision-language-action models reliable via test-time sampling, verification and scaling
Reasoning-centric end-to-end autonomous driving (world models, chain-of-thought, long-tail cases)
Runtime out-of-distribution failure detection and guardrailing for deployed embodied systems
Data flywheels: influence-function data curation and closed-loop retraining of robot policies
Transformer-based spacecraft trajectory generation and space rendezvous mission design
